questions.question: Which sentence follows correct manner-place-time order?
questions.explanation: (also acceptable as a variant order, but the standard end-position sequence is manner→place→time)
answers: She sang beautifully at the concert last night.
She sang last night beautifully at the concert.
She sang at the concert last night beautifully.

questions.question: "He works out regularly at the gym" — where does the frequency-type adverb "regularly" go relative to "at the gym"?
questions.explanation: See the Order of adverbs lesson for the underlying rule.
answers: Immediately after the verb/verb phrase, before the place
At the very start of the sentence

questions.question: Reorder: (a few minutes ago / quietly / the room / left / they)
questions.explanation: See the Order of adverbs lesson for the underlying rule.
answers: They left quietly the room a few minutes ago.
They quietly left the room a few minutes ago.
They left the room quietly a few minutes ago.
A few minutes ago they left quietly the room.
